## Automated gates
- [ ] `test` passes
- [ ] `security` passes
- [ ] `compliance-static` passes
- [ ] `build` passes

## Manual compliance impact
Mark whether this PR changes any of the following:
- [ ] external provider
- [ ] endpoint / API version
- [ ] requested provider fields
- [ ] caching / retention
- [ ] scheduled monitoring frequency
- [ ] analytics / logging
- [ ] pricing / discount display
- [ ] affiliate behavior
- [ ] user / account data handling
- [ ] category (shopping / flight / hotel / other)

If any item above changes:
- [ ] `docs/COMPLIANCE.md` updated
- [ ] `docs/PROVIDER_REGISTRY.md` updated if applicable
- [ ] manual provider/compliance review completed or explicitly marked `Review Required`

`merge != publish`: merging a PR does not approve PUBLIC_BETA.
